Well, this pill works about just like Ambien for me, puts me to sleep, gives me a milder version of that Ambien-stoning; However-- it tastes like shit!!!  I'm not BSing here, one of the side effects of this pill is perverted taste perceptions-- and basically what that means is that anything I drink will taste like a combo of Green cough syrup and codiene juice. BITTER is what I'm trying to say. These pills make me thirsty and then I can't drink anything because even water tastes like shit!
